subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as the public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` completion-routing contract?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it creates model-facing tool semantics, operator config defaults, and persisted session-routing behavior in compatibility-sensitive message-delivery code.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land this PR or an equivalent after confirming current-head proof while keeping `channel` as the backward-compatible default.

options.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option and defer global/per-agent defaults until operator-policy implications are clearer.

options.title: Pause the public contract
options.body: Keep the callback workaround and hold this PR until maintainers choose a broader orchestration API direction.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land this PR or an equivalent after confirming current-head proof while keeping `channel` as the backward-compatible default.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest prior issue-review and recent session/subagent routing history for the public contract choice.
